subject: english
question:
in the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts-P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

Ravi opened his new geometry box.

P: It had a ruler, compass, and protractor.

Q: He used it in his maths class.

R: He showed it to his friends.

S: It was made of metal and looked shiny.

6. He liked his new box very much.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph begins by introducing Ravi and his new geometry box.
 
• **Sentence P comes first** as it describes the contents of the geometry box:
 
 
• "It had a ruler, compass, and protractor."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R follows** as Ravi shows the box to his friends:
 
 
• "He showed it to his friends."
 
 
 
• **Sentence Q comes next** as Ravi uses the box in his maths class:
 
 
• "He used it in his maths class."
 
 
 
• **Sentence S is placed last** before the concluding sentence, describing the box’s appearance:
 
 
• "It was made of metal and looked shiny."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **PRQS**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Ravi opened his new geometry box. It had a ruler, compass, and protractor. He showed it to his friends. He used it in his maths class. It was made of metal and looked shiny. He liked his new box very much."
